duties.presentationFunction: Establish repeatable service work: receive a bounded task, confirm ownership, complete the handoff, and close the loop.
duties.milestoneRelation: No transition; establishes baseline duty grammar before the first milestone.
duties.repetitionAvoidance: Introduces the service-rotation grammar once; later Service Rotation duties change context rather than restating orientation.

duties.presentationFunction: Resolve a route/handoff mismatch using a baseline route, with optional access or pass recognition variants.
duties.milestoneRelation: This is the exact duty-2 completion that transitions Entered Service -> Working Rhythm and queues milestone-02.
duties.repetitionAvoidance: First route-focused duty; differs from Duty 1 by path selection and access-context variants.

duties.presentationFunction: Compare a register with a concrete handoff and distinguish verified information from an unchecked assumption.
duties.milestoneRelation: First duty after milestone-02; demonstrates the newly unlocked Records Review family.
duties.repetitionAvoidance: Switches from physical routing to document/evidence verification.

duties.presentationFunction: Handle competing routine requests while preserving queue/order rather than solving the task by personal favor.
duties.milestoneRelation: Middle Working Rhythm duty; no stage transition.
duties.repetitionAvoidance: Reuses the family with queue-pressure and boundary presentation instead of the first-duty handoff.

duties.presentationFunction: Reroute a delayed handoff through a safe baseline route; optional terrain/staff-access knowledge changes presentation only.
duties.milestoneRelation: Exact duty-5 completion transitions Working Rhythm -> Trusted Service and queues milestone-05.
duties.repetitionAvoidance: Second logistics duty introduces rerouting under delay rather than pass-checking from Duty 2.

duties.presentationFunction: Coordinate two bounded workstreams with explicit responsibilities and a shared verification point.
duties.milestoneRelation: First Trusted Service duty; unlocks the coordination presentation surface after milestone-05.
duties.repetitionAvoidance: Introduces multi-person coordination rather than solo service/logistics/records work.

duties.presentationFunction: Review a material record where observation and explanation must remain separate.
duties.milestoneRelation: Trusted Service duty with no transition.
duties.repetitionAvoidance: Records Review now concerns physical/material evidence rather than the register mismatch in Duty 3.

duties.presentationFunction: Close a longer service chain by confirming what was completed, what remains open, and who owns the next step.
duties.milestoneRelation: Exact duty-8 completion transitions Trusted Service -> Palace Network and queues milestone-08.
duties.repetitionAvoidance: Third Service Rotation changes from direct handoff/queue pressure to multi-step closure and accountability.

duties.presentationFunction: Handle a formal-facing work exchange where protocol supports clarity but never substitutes for actual authorization.
duties.milestoneRelation: First Palace Network duty; introduces the Formal Interface family.
duties.repetitionAvoidance: New protocol/formal presentation axis distinct from earlier work families.

duties.presentationFunction: Coordinate a shared result where credit, correction, and responsibility must remain traceable.
duties.milestoneRelation: Palace Network duty; no structural transition.
duties.repetitionAvoidance: Coordination revisits the family through authorship/credit and boundary choices rather than task-splitting from Duty 6.

duties.presentationFunction: Plan a handoff through a constrained route while distinguishing official attention, route evidence, and actual access.
duties.milestoneRelation: Palace Network duty; no structural transition.
duties.repetitionAvoidance: Third logistics duty combines route constraints and verified official context rather than simple access/rerouting.

duties.presentationFunction: Reconcile multiple records into a single checked summary while preserving source disagreements.
duties.milestoneRelation: Exact duty-12 completion transitions Palace Network -> Crossroads and queues milestone-12.
duties.repetitionAvoidance: Third Records Review moves from one discrepancy/material observation to multi-source reconciliation.

duties.presentationFunction: Separate direct observation, sourced testimony, and unresolved interpretation without declaring a final mystery truth.
duties.milestoneRelation: First Crossroads duty; introduces Evidence Review and may expose optional Inner Truth preparation afterward.
duties.repetitionAvoidance: Only Evidence Review duty in the required 15; creates a distinct late-stage analysis presentation.

duties.presentationFunction: Present a checked position in a formal setting while keeping performance, protocol, and factual certainty separate.
duties.milestoneRelation: Crossroads duty with no structural transition.
duties.repetitionAvoidance: Second formal duty shifts from protocol execution to presenting a bounded checked position.

duties.presentationFunction: Coordinate a final general-work handoff across several roles and close all ordinary Palace progression obligations without choosing an ending.
duties.milestoneRelation: Exact duty-15 completion transitions Crossroads -> Outcome Ready, writes palace.progression-complete exactly once, and queues milestone-15.
duties.repetitionAvoidance: Final coordination duty is a multi-role closure beat, not a repeat of Duty 6 task splitting or Duty 10 credit handling.

fifteenDutyMap.invariant: Every required duty remains a normal +1 Palace duty under v11. Authoring changes presentation and optional variants only; it never changes count weight or daily cadence.

preparationBeats.function: Ask whether ordinary Palace service can be made sustainable through clear responsibilities and repeatable work rather than status.
preparationBeats.baselineInput: A completed Palace duty at Trusted Service or later.

preparationBeats.function: Confirm a bounded service pattern and professional limits; accepting the beat records preparation without excluding other routes.
preparationBeats.baselineInput: Service Life beat 01 completed or available baseline continuation.

routes.currentLifeResolution: After explicit ending commit, resolve a current-life continuation-of-service scene; final story details remain authored-content work and do not alter other runs before completeEnding.

preparationBeats.function: Frame influence as accountable coordination: what responsibility can be accepted, traced, and refused when outside authority.
preparationBeats.baselineInput: A completed Palace duty at Palace Network or later.

preparationBeats.function: Resolve a professional network/credit decision without requiring patronage, romance, or personal favor.
preparationBeats.baselineInput: Court Power beat 01 completed or available baseline continuation.

routes.currentLifeResolution: After explicit ending commit, resolve the current-life professional-authority outcome; no reward mechanic is implied by the authored scene.

preparationBeats.function: Sort evidence by observed / sourced / unresolved without naming a final mystery truth.
preparationBeats.baselineInput: A completed Evidence Review or another baseline Palace duty at Crossroads.

preparationBeats.function: Compare two plausible accounts and preserve uncertainty where the evidence does not settle it.
preparationBeats.baselineInput: Inner Truth beat 01 completed or available no-item baseline continuation.

routes.currentLifeResolution: After explicit ending commit, resolve a current-life inquiry/understanding outcome without declaring the game's final mystery answer.

outcomeRoutes.coexistence: All three preparation facts and all three ready facts may coexist before the player explicitly commits an ending.

relationships.use: Optional professional-review/trust/boundary variants for Coordination, Court Power preparation, and post-duty reactions.
Optional personal route only; refusal-safe and irrelevant to all Palace progression/outcome gates.

night.use: Optional professional review of documents/routes/current work.
Optional workplace/social context without mandatory relationship progression.

d35PrivateSpaceBranch.prerequisiteMode: Only after the player has voluntarily kept a personal/romance-capable relationship route open.
d35PrivateSpaceBranch.cheapOrStreetBehavior: Branch is unavailable; romance/progression/outcomes remain otherwise unchanged.
d35PrivateSpaceBranch.secretDebtBehavior: Forced Secret Debt Night suppresses this voluntary branch.

ordinaryCareerLegacyKnowledge.bindingStatus: CONTENT-SLOT READY; exact pure-knowledge unlock IDs are not authored here because D27 locks semantics but not this Palace naming layer.
ordinaryCareerLegacyKnowledge.rule: Career knowledge may change explanatory/presentation variants only. It never substitutes for D23, items, School, Activities, Palace relationships, or duty completion.

topics.use: bounded repetitive work, closure, route/work safety context
service queue, guest-facing boundaries, routine continuity
service flow, confirmed information, staff-space context
official access, responsibility, checked route constraints
formal presentation, shared credit, protocol-facing context
route/evidence separation, conflicting accounts, bounded intel context

school.rule: School is optional context only. A course may add a variant when its subject matches the duty/route; no School counter/course is a Palace gate.

activities.rule: Activity experience/result may add one optional contextual response; no Activity is required and no Activity result increments palaceDutyCount.

items.rule: Capabilities provide variants/choices only; no item grants access, stage progression, outcome readiness, Prince access, or Return Home.

relationships.rule: Relationship state changes optional responses only. Baseline duty/route choices remain available without each relationship.

trueEndingHandoff.confrontationModel: FROZEN v9 authority; not selected by v12.

cap200Reward.timing: only after Return Home completion through the normal ending transaction
cap200Reward.effect: maximum of each of the 12 progression stats becomes 200 instead of 100

excludedFromCoreCount: Prince confrontation scenes: frozen v9 model is not selected.
Return Home final authored scene/epilogue: final mystery/lore is not locked.

localizationSurface.definition: A surface is one localized title/body/choice-label/choice-result/action-label/action-description field. Counts are minimum blueprint fields, not final prose length.
excludedOpenLocalization: non-True reward description copy while reward status is OPEN

mediaSlotClasses.use: Service Rotation, Logistics Support, Records Review, Coordination baseline staging

contentBudget.genericStagingReuse: All required Palace core scenes can ship with generic Palace entry/work/formal/review staging classes. Only later presentation polish may request unique art. D35 private-space content can reuse a generic normal-lodging private-room class and must not appear for cheap/street.

acceptanceMatrix.assertion: Exactly 15 authored duty entries exist and duty numbers are 1..15 without gaps or duplicates.
Duty family distribution matches v11 stage availability and all six families appear.
Structural transitions remain exactly duties 2,5,8,12,15; authored mapping cannot move milestones.
Every duty has a presentation function, stat/capability emphasis, optional hooks, must-not-gate list, milestone relation and repetition-avoidance note.
Every duty remains +1 palaceDutyCount and no optional hook changes duty weight.
No Palace daily cadence is created by the authored map.
Service Life prep starts no earlier than Trusted Service.
Court Power prep starts no earlier than Palace Network.
Inner Truth prep starts no earlier than Crossroads.
Each non-True route has two preparation beats, one preparation fact, one Outcome Ready finalize scene, one final-ready fact, and one post-commit current-life resolution scene.
All non-True preparation and ready facts may coexist before explicit ending commit.
No route requires romance, Palace Night, legacy items, School, Activities or a specific relationship.
Non-True reward status remains OPEN and authored route text cannot imply a permanent reward.
Professional review/social Night are optional and never count as Palace duties.
Patron/contact/rival relationships only add optional variants and refusal/disengagement never removes baseline Palace content.
Optional romance is refusal-safe and never gates Palace progression/outcomes/True Ending.
D35 private-space branch requires normal lodging only, disappears on cheap/street, and is never required for romance/progression/endings.
Forced Secret Debt Night suppresses both ordinary Palace Night and D35 private-space Palace branch.
All eight shipped School courses are optional variant sources only.
All three shipped Activities are optional variant sources only and cannot increment Palace duty count.
All ten v5 Palace legacy capability hooks exist and remain non-gating.
Ordinary-career knowledge has one authored slot per ordinary career but exact pure-knowledge machine IDs remain unguessed.
True handoff requires Outcome Ready + palace.progression-complete + all 12 stats >=91, excludes Lust, and then uses frozen v9 confrontation authority.
Prince defeat never auto-commits Return Home.
cap-200 appears only after Return Home completion, is a one-slot Specialist under D27/D28, and never multiplies current values.
Required core scene budget is exactly 37 and reconciles to the scene inventory.
Optional authored-unit budget is exactly 45: 23 reusable v5 units + 22 new variant slots.
Minimum required localization surface is exactly 150 fields per language / 300 bilingual fields, excluding explicitly open Prince/Return Home/reward prose.
Optional localization budget is 113 fields per language / 226 bilingual fields.
Seven media slot classes cover the blueprint and required core content can reuse generic Palace staging.
No final Prince name/lore, confrontation-model selection, mystery truth or production runtime/UI is introduced.

explicitNonGoals: No confrontation model selection beyond frozen v9 authority.
No permanent rewards for the three non-True outcomes until Product locks them.
No romance, Night, item, School, Activity or relationship gate.
